messages:
rachel: Looping back from the postmortem: recurring paging from redis_p99 during deployments. We need quick wins and a tracker.

owen: I can do a rule audit and split redis_p99 into read/write buckets. read spikes during rolling deploys can be deprioritized. ETA 2 days.

diego: Suggest a temporary suppression during known deploy windows: 20m before -> 40m after deploy starts. Could be orchestration-driven.

rachel: ownership draft: owen -> alert split + PR (48h), diego -> deploy-driven suppression playbook (24h), rachel -> dashboard + success criteria (tomorrow).

oncall-bot: Reminder: any change that affects paging must be added to infra/runbooks.

owen: quick example for split rule:
```yaml
- alert: redis_read_p99
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redis_read_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, host, cluster)) > 80
  for: 2m
```
And a write rule similar with a higher threshold.

diego: orchestration hooks example (k8s deploy controller emits annotation): when annotation present, silence matching redis_read_p99 for affected hosts. opsctl has a hook.

rachel: metrics to measure: pages/during-deploy, pages/outside-deploy, uniq_hosts_alerting, missed-incident-count (investigate for any suppressed pages that correlate with user reports). Target: cut deploy-time pages by 90% with zero missed critical incidents.

oncall-bot: New: add runbook PR label @eng-sre.

owen: PR link incoming.

diego: implementing temp silence command now. will test dry-run in staging.

rachel: weekly check-in Friday 10:00 PT. I'll update the incident tracker and close this loop when validated.
